energy_scope: Sum of absolute joint mechanical power sampled at 50Hz; excludes electronics, efficiency, regeneration, battery and motor heat
randomization: Mass 0.9-1.1, torso COM +/-15mm, PD 0.85-1.15, effort 0.85-1.0, friction 0.65-0.95, target delay 0-20ms, velocity kicks +/-0.25m/s every 7-12s; training observation corruption enabled
terrain: Synthetic height noise -15..25mm and waves 15..40mm amplitude range; not a certification of outdoor terrain
